overview_description.description: Marefa Digital is an EdTech company that provides Arab professionals with eLearning tools and content to create, publish and learn in Arabic. Marefa Digital's mission is to empower Arab professionals and institutions to create their own eLearning content through our proprietary authoring tool. We are leveraging our eLearning Platforms which provide dynamic reporting and analytics functionalities to Educators and Organizations.We are building a vast eLearning content library in Arabic for professional development. We aim to be the largest premium eLearning content provider in Arabic in the MENA region.
